title: A Restaurant Complaint
summary: A customer politely complains about a wrong order and the waiter fixes the problem.

lines.speaker: Luís
lines.pt: Com licença, Marcos. Acho que houve um engano no meu pedido.
lines.en: Excuse me, Marcos. I think there was a mistake with my order.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Sinto muito, Luís. O que aconteceu?

lines.speaker: Luís
lines.pt: Eu pedi peixe grelhado, mas recebi frango.
lines.en: I ordered grilled fish, but I received chicken.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: O senhor tem razão. A mesa ao lado também pediu frango; devo ter trocado os pratos.
lines.en: You are right. The table next to you also ordered chicken; I must have switched the dishes.

lines.speaker: Luís
lines.pt: Tudo bem, acontece. Também pedi a salada sem cebola.
lines.en: That's okay, it happens. I also asked for the salad without onion.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Peço desculpas. Vou avisar a cozinha agora e conferir antes de trazer.
lines.en: I apologize. I'll tell the kitchen now and check before bringing it.

lines.speaker: Luís
lines.pt: Obrigado. Eu só estou com um pouco de pressa por causa do cinema.
lines.en: Thank you. I'm just in a bit of a hurry because of the movie.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Entendo. Vou pedir prioridade para o seu prato.
lines.en: I understand. I'll ask for priority for your dish.

lines.speaker: Luís
lines.pt: Agradeço. O restaurante está cheio hoje.
lines.en: I appreciate it. The restaurant is full today.

lines.speaker: Marcos
lines.pt: Para compensar, a sobremesa ficará por conta da casa.
lines.en: To make up for it, dessert will be on the house.

lines.speaker: Luís
lines.pt: Obrigado pela atenção, Marcos. Assim fica resolvido.
lines.en: Thank you for your attention, Marcos. That settles it.

comprehension.question: What was wrong with the salad request?
How does the restaurant compensate the customer?
